my.pageNote: Your own boards. Nobody else sees them.

my.resetBody: This replaces this board’s widgets with the default set. It can’t be undone.
my.cancelBody: Discard the changes you made in this editing session? The board returns to how it was when you opened Customize.

shared.pageNote: The board every user sees. Only an admin can change it.
shared.editingWarning: Editing the shared dashboard — changes are visible to all users.
shared.loadSlow: Loading the shared dashboard is taking longer than expected.

shared.confirmEditBody: Changes you make here apply to every user — everyone’s Shared Dashboard updates. Continue?
shared.resetBody: This replaces the shared dashboard’s widgets with the default set — for all users. It can’t be undone.
shared.cancelBody: Discard the changes you made in this editing session? The shared dashboard returns to how it was when you opened Customize.

save.expired: Your session expired — sign in again to save dashboard changes.
save.forbidden: You don’t have permission to change the shared dashboard.
save.failed: Couldn’t save your dashboard changes. They’ll be retried on your next edit.

boardTabs.removeLastTitle: A dashboard needs at least one board
boardTabs.removeBody: Remove “{{name}}” and its widgets? This can’t be undone.

widgetFrame.resizeHint: Drag to resize (arrow keys also work)

catalog.title: Add a widget
catalog.plannedHint: Planned — the data backend for this widget is not available yet

status-summary.title: Status summary
status-summary.blurb: Total node count + breakdown by state.

health-ring.title: Health ring
health-ring.blurb: Donut of healthy / warning / critical with % healthy.

nodes-down.title: Nodes down
nodes-down.blurb: Big-number tile: nodes currently critical or unreachable.

fleet-health-timeline.title: Fleet health timeline
fleet-health-timeline.blurb: Down / warning / unknown node counts over the last 24h.

active-alerts.title: Active alerts
active-alerts.blurb: Worst-first live feed of firing alerts.

alert-volume.title: Alert volume
alert-volume.blurb: Alerts opened per hour over the last 24h.

severity-mix.title: Severity mix
severity-mix.blurb: Donut of active alerts by severity.

top-alerting-nodes.title: Top alerting nodes
top-alerting-nodes.blurb: Nodes generating the most alerts (chronic offenders).

alert-calendar.title: Alert calendar
alert-calendar.blurb: Hour × weekday heatmap of alert volume (7 days).

top-cpu.title: Top CPU
top-cpu.blurb: Nodes with the highest CPU usage % (vendor-reported).

top-memory.title: Top memory
top-memory.blurb: Nodes with the highest memory usage % (vendor-reported).

busiest-interfaces.title: Busiest interfaces
busiest-interfaces.blurb: Highest-throughput links, utilization % where speed is known.

most-interface-discards.title: Most interface discards
most-interface-discards.blurb: Links dropping the most frames/sec (in+out) — congestion, not damage.

top-talkers.title: Top talkers
top-talkers.blurb: Interfaces moving the most bits now (in+out).

aggregate-throughput.title: Aggregate throughput
aggregate-throughput.blurb: Sum of all interface traffic, in + out (bits/sec), over 24h.

interface-heatmap.title: Interface utilization heatmap
interface-heatmap.blurb: Busiest links × time, shaded by throughput.

interface-traffic.title: Interface traffic
interface-traffic.blurb: Up to six interfaces you pick, across nodes. In above the line, out below.

traffic-spikes.title: Traffic spikes
traffic-spikes.blurb: Interfaces whose throughput jumped most vs 5m ago.

traffic-drops.title: Traffic drops
traffic-drops.blurb: Interfaces whose throughput fell most vs 5m ago (possible outage).

site-matrix.title: Site health matrix
site-matrix.blurb: A tile per node-group: worst member state + up/total.

geo-map.title: Geo map
geo-map.blurb: Sites plotted by coordinates, pin colored by worst state.

dependency-view.title: Dependency / root cause
dependency-view.blurb: Parent→child dependency tree showing the upstream node blamed as root cause.

poller-health.title: Poller & collection health
poller-health.blurb: Last poll run, jobs per run, results collected.

data-coverage.title: Data coverage
data-coverage.blurb: Gauge: % of nodes returning fresh data (blind-spot detector).

stale-data.title: Stale data watchlist
stale-data.blurb: Nodes whose last sample is overdue (silent failures).

event-volume.title: Event volume
event-volume.blurb: Events received per hour over the last 24h.

event-triage-mix.title: Event outcomes
event-triage-mix.blurb: How the pipeline triaged events (fired / cleared / …).

event-rule-coverage.title: Rule coverage
event-rule-coverage.blurb: Share of events matched by a rule.

flow-conversations.title: Conversations
flow-conversations.blurb: Top src→dst flows as a Sankey.

metric-chart.title: Metric chart
metric-chart.blurb: Any one metric of any one node, over 6h — including metrics no other card covers.

metric-top.title: Top nodes by metric
metric-top.blurb: The highest-value nodes for any metric name you type — including metrics no other card covers.

fleetTimeline.empty: No history yet — state snapshots accrue every 5 minutes.

activeAlerts.empty: No active alerts. All monitored nodes are healthy.

flapping.empty: No flapping checks. State is stable.

alertVolume.empty: No alerts opened in the last 24h.
alertVolume.aria: alerts opened per hour over the last 24 hours

alertCalendar.empty: No alerts in the last 7 days.

ifTraffic.pickSome: Pick one or more interfaces to plot.
ifTraffic.noneYet: Nothing plotted yet. Choose a node, then one of its interfaces.
ifTraffic.full: {{max}} is the maximum — the chart has {{max}} colours, and a seventh line would reuse one.
ifTraffic.allPicked: Every interface on this node is already plotted
ifTraffic.unavailable: No longer reported by the node: {{links}}
ifTraffic.unitTitle: Bits per second, or unicast packets per second (multicast and broadcast are not counted)

regionRollup.empty: No top-level groups with members yet.

geoMap.empty: No geo-located sites. Set coordinates on a group to plot it.
geoMap.aria: sites positioned by coordinates, colored by worst state

maintenance.empty: Nothing in maintenance now or scheduled.

staleData.empty: All nodes are reporting fresh data. 🎉

pollerHealth.poolsHint: Pools whose nodes are pushed to a live poller as a working set, versus pools falling back to per-job publish because no poller is registered and alive for them.
pollerHealth.workingSetHint: Working-set pushes since core started: full snapshots and incremental deltas. A rising snapshot count means pollers keep resyncing.
pollerHealth.mirrorWritesHint: Rewrites of the Redis poller-assignment mirror since core started. Redis is rebuildable, so this is a churn signal, not a durability one.

discovery.empty: No pending discoveries. Run a scan from Nodes → Discovery.

audit.forbidden: Recent changes require an admin role to view.

eventVolume.aria: events received per hour over the last 24 hours

metricChart.pickNode: Pick a node, then one of its metrics.
metricChart.unavailable: {{metric}} is not available on this node.
metricChart.empty: No data in the last 6 hours…

metricTop.pickMetric: Type a metric name to rank the fleet by.
metricTop.counter: {{metric}} is a counter. Ranking its stored value would rank how long each node has been up, not how busy it is.
metricTop.empty: No node is reporting {{metric}}. The name has to match exactly — a node's Collection tab lists the ones it has.

rankedBars.partial: This ranking covers only the groups your account can see, and may be missing entries.
